title: Make radio state and GPS continue screen-off on XP5900
description: Rehome LocationProvider startup from MapScreen, persist channel state, implement local TTS/tone announcements, verify Android foreground-service behavior and screen-off PLI/TAK on Sonim XP5900 (XP5plus).
acceptance_criteria: Screen-off TAK receive/reconnect, fresh own PLI, XP5900 knob channel switching and local announcement verified on the actual device; older XP5 remains unverified.

title: Implement channel state and XP5900 input profile
description: Create app-owned presets and logical input layer with generic D-pad fallback. On the confirmed Sonim XP5900 (XP5plus), capture device knob/PTT events and app-level delivery before offering optional device defaults; earlier XP5 hardware remains unverified. Persist user-editable per-device input-to-logical-action bindings and selector-position-to-preset mapping, with a button-operated learn/rebind/reset flow. Include screen-off input delivery gate and held-PTT channel deferral (no transmission).
acceptance_criteria: Tests for relative/absolute selector, debounce/wrap, and persistent remapping/held-PTT behavior; mappings are editable without touch or hardcoded to XP5900 raw codes. XP5900 display-off knob changes channel in the app or a documented blocking limitation is recorded.

title: Provision Android 36/JDK 17 toolchain and XP5 diagnostics
description: Android Studio SDK 36/adb and JBR21 now support local builds; default Java26 still fails. Connected Sonim XP5900 (XP5plus) runs Android 11/API30. Capture raw screen-on/off knob/PTT and app-level delivery without storing private identifiers; earlier XP5 remains unverified.
acceptance_criteria: Local assembleDebug/testDebugUnitTest pass and XP5900 raw knob/PTT sequences are captured with screen on/off; identify documented app-level delivery or report a concrete blocker.
notes: XP5900 (XP5plus, Android 11/API30): screen-on and screen-off clockwise event4 emits 0x2ef down/up; screen-on counterclockwise event5 emits 0x2f0 down/up. A screen-off event5 capture was empty despite reported turns; repeat. Debug-only app-level RadioInputProbe on release/xp5900-input-probe at 3d8b7fe, locally assembled/tested, installed, focused, and pushed; foreground input delivery not yet established. Do not treat kernel events or Sonim keylayout as fixed app bindings. CI run 41907584291 pending. No serial/identifiers recorded.

title: Establish fork and document upstream boundaries
description: True GitHub fork, distinct app identity, technical assessment and reproducible build gate. Upstream pinned d1569ae; local machine lacks JDK 17 and Android SDK, CI validation needed.
acceptance_criteria: Fork parent verified, attribution retained, app label/id distinct, assessment captures TAK/map/location dependencies, build/test results recorded.
close_reason: Fork verified, identity/manifest assessment committed; JDK 17 CI assembleDebug and testDebugUnitTest passed (run 41890412060).

title: Remove map renderer and preserve TAK pipelines
description: Replace MapScreen/nav and remove MapLibre, Cesium, tile and map-only plugin dependencies incrementally. Preserve CoT, chat, contact, cert, GPS and PLI flows; audit UserPrefs/ConfigProfile persistence compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: Mapless APK compiles; MapLibre absent from runtime dependency graph; simulated TAK server sees inbound contacts and outbound PLI.

title: Stop stale live PLI after GPS privilege ends
description: RadioLocationSession stops fused updates when permission is revoked, the location FGS times out, or only dataSync remains. LocationProvider retains the previous non-restored fix and SelfPositionBroadcaster currently stamps it as a new CoT on each tick. Add an explicit freshness/availability gate that preserves intentional manual-position override, resumes immediately on a new live fix, and covers expiry/permission-loss/reconnect with tests.
acceptance_criteria: No stale GPS coordinate is republished as fresh PLI after location updates stop; manual override and fresh fix recovery remain correct; screen-off TAK tests cover service fallback.

title: Replace UI and setup with button-only radio shell
description: Build radio home, channels, contacts, messages/canned replies, location/status/settings and first-run manual/provisioned setup with deterministic focus and certificate import accessible without touch. Settings includes a button-operated hardware input learn/rebind/reset flow and preset mapping; never require touching a fixed XP5900 binding.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh-install setup, navigation, hardware-binding configuration and canned reply complete with D-pad/Select/Back without touchscreen; include instrumentation tests.
